newsitem.title: HUNGARY: ARANYPOK TO ISSUE BONDS OF HUF 100 MLN.
newsitem.headline: ARANYPOK TO ISSUE BONDS OF HUF 100 MLN.

text.p: Hungarian clothes retailer Aranypok Rt 's board has decided to raise 100 million forints via a public bond issue, a company official said on Tuesday.
"The raised funds would be spent on the development of the retail chain and the financing of trading activities," Aranypok Deputy General Director Marta Novak told Reuters.
She said they will publish details of the issue once the Money and Capital Markets Supervision (APTF) has approved their request for the public bond issue.
On the Budapest Stock Exchange Aranypok shares closed at 7,200 forints on Monday.
